english.note: Mostly used in 化妝 or 化咗妝, to put on makeup.

exampleSentences.english: Don’t play dumb. Your lips are that red, and you still say you didn’t put on makeup?
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔好扮嘢喎。個嘴紅到噉樣重唔係化咗妝？
